en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
af: Die lug is op stil en die ry ook. Maandag het nog nie sy volume gekry nie.
zu: Isibhakabhaka sithulile, nolayini uthulile. UMsombuluko awukayitholi ivolumu.

en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
af: Lug en see het vanoggend oor 'n kleur ooreengekom. Nie 'n opwindende een nie.
zu: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle kuvumelene ngombala ekuseni. Akuwona umbala ojabulisayo.

en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
af: Selfs die hadida hou dit sag. Die lug het die toon aangegee.
zu: Ngisho ne-hadeda ithule. Isibhakabhaka yisona esibeke isimo.

en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
af: Geen skaduwees, geen skittering, geen verskonings nie. Maandag onder 'n Tupperware-deksel.
zu: Azikho izithunzi, akukho ukukhazimula, azikho izaba. UMsombuluko ungaphansi kwesivalo se-Tupperware.

en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
af: Die son gaan nie vandag die blink kom inspekteer nie. Die kar is tevrede.
zu: Ilanga ngeke lize lizohlola ukukhazimula namuhla. Imoto ayinankinga ngalokho.

en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
af: Nie een skaduwee op die veld die hele dag nie. Die skeidsregter het nie een keer sy oë op skrefies getrek nie.
zu: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange avale amehlo ngenxa yelanga.

en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
af: Grys lug, truie aan, skool is uit. Die naweek vra nie die son se toestemming nie.
zu: Isibhakabhaka esimpunga, amajezi agqokiwe, isikole siphumile. Impelasonto ayidingi imvume yelanga.

en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
af: Die hele veld met die kleur afgedraai. Die skape tel dieselfde, hoe ook al.
zu: Ithafa lonke linombala owehlisiwe. Inani lezimvu liyafana noma kunjani.

en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
af: Die skuur se gloeilamp is vanaand se sonsondergang. Die beeste aanvaar die afgradering.
zu: Isibani esibayeni yikho ukushona kwelanga kulobu busuku. Izinkomo ziyakwamukela ukwehliswa.

en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
af: Die lug het van liggrys na donkergrys gegaan. Dit was die hele vertoning.
zu: Isibhakabhaka sisuke empunga ekhanyayo saya empunga emnyama. Yilowo wonke umbukiso.

en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
af: Die sekuriteitslig het vroeg aangegaan. Die son het nooit behoorlik ingeklok nie.
zu: Isibani sezokuphepha sikhanyise kusenesikhathi. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kahle.

en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
af: See en lug in bypassende grys. Net die pier se liggies het moeite gedoen.
zu: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kumpunga ngokufanayo. Izibani zasesikhumulweni kuphela ezizamile.

en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
af: Die vlag gee die voorspelling voor die branderplankryers. Dit sê: gaan.
zu: Ifulegi linikeza isibikezelo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: hambani.

en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
af: Die jakarandablomme ry ook bus. Die bries het hulle kaartjies gekoop.
zu: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane.

en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
af: Die windpomp doen die oggend se werk. Die gras waai hom net aan.
zu: Impompi yomoya yenza umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayikhuthaza nje.

en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
af: Hand op die pet, een tree op 'n slag. Die bries hou haar pas.
zu: Isandla ekepisini, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Umoya omncane uhamba naye.

en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
af: Die wasgoed is droog voor eerste pouse. Die bries het vroeg begin werk.
zu: Izingubo zizobe zomile ngaphambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncane uqale umsebenzi kusenesikhathi.

en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
af: 'n Klein stofduiweltjie ry voor hom uit. Dit trap nie eens nie.
zu: Isivunguvungu esincane sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Futhi asizihluphi ngokushova.

en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
af: Haar hare was eerste by die bakkery. Die bries het sy eie Sondagplanne.
zu: Izinwele zakhe zifike kuqala esitolo sesinkwa. Umoya omncane unezinhlelo zawo zangeSonto.

en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
af: Pouse, en die bries doen almal se hare. Die juffrouens ook.
zu: Yisikhathi sekhefu, futhi umoya omncane ulungisa izinwele zabo bonke. Nothisha.

en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
af: Die bries werk vandag by die vrugtestalletjie. Lugverkoeling ingesluit, geen ekstra koste nie.
zu: Umoya omncane usebenza etafuleni lezithelo namuhla. I-air-con ifakiwe, ayikho imali eyengeziwe.

en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
af: Die bries doen al die werk. Die vlieër kry al die eer.
zu: Umoya wenza wonke umsebenzi. I-kite ithatha lonke udumo.

en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
af: Die hoekvlag wys presies waarheen die doelskoppe gaan trek.
zu: Ifulegi lasekhoneni likhomba ngqo lapho ibhola lizophambukela khona.

en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
af: Die lakens is al droog. Nou spog die bries net vir die kind.
zu: Amashidi asomile kakade. Manje umoya omncane uziqhayisa nje enganeni.

en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
af: Die rook het die bure se erf gekry. Saterdag se braai is amptelik 'n gemeenskapsgeleentheid.
zu: Intuthu ifike egcekeni labomakhelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo manje ingumcimbi womphakathi ngokusemthethweni.

en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
af: Skoene op die kombers se hoeke. Die bries is welkom, die sand nie.
zu: Izicathulo emakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.

en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
af: Vlae styf uit, wynglas styf vas. Die dek se weergawe van 'n kalm Maandag.
zu: Amafulegi aqonde ngqo, iwayini libanjwe ngokuqinile. Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo uMsombuluko ozolile.

en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
af: Die stof gaan vir goud in die laaste lig. Die wedstryd speel daardeur voort.
zu: Uthuli lukhazimula njengegolide ekukhanyeni kokushona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.

en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
af: Die heuwel beweeg in golwe. Die beeste het besluit om dit nie raak te sien nie.
zu: Igquma linyakaza ngamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukungaboni lutho.

en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
af: Die bries skuif die jakaranda een straat aan, blommetjie vir blommetjie. Die stoep keur dit goed.
zu: Umoya omncane uthutha i-jacaranda iye komunye umgwaqo, imbali ngembali. I-stoep iyavuma.

en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
af: Die wasgoed moes ure gelede al in gewees het. Die bries het gestem om dit te los.
zu: Izingubo bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule. Umoya omncane uvote ukuthi zisale.

en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
af: Die vlae gesels nog. Die bote het die week afgesluit.
zu: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe seziyiqedile iviki.

en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
af: Die blare laat die sekuriteitslig aanhoudend aanskakel. Die hond staan nie meer op daarvoor nie.
zu: Amaqabunga ahlala ekhanyisa isibani sezokuphepha. Inja ayisasukumi ngenxa yawo.

en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
af: Iemand het die wasgoed vergeet. Die bries nie, en dit doen 'n pragtige werk.
zu: Othile ukhohliwe izingubo. Umoya omncane wona awukhohlwanga, futhi wenza umsebenzi omuhle.

en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
af: Die bries is nog warm op hierdie uur. Die see los die verwarming die hele nag aan.
zu: Umoya omncane usafudumele ngalesi sikhathi. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
af: Die windpomp glo nie aan afklopstyd nie. Die hond ook nie.
zu: Impompi yomoya ayikholelwa esikhathini sokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa kuso.

en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
af: Die bries vat die rook met die straat af. Die hele buurt weet wat vir aandete is.
zu: Umoya omncane uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo. Wonke umgwaqo uyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.

en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
af: Elke liggie aan die string swaai. Saterdagaand het ritme, net-net.
zu: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi, kancane nje.

en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
af: Die sand steek die pad oor, een korrel op 'n slag. Niemand hier het haas nie.
zu: Isihlabathi siwela umgwaqo inhlamvu ngenhlamvu. Akekho lapha ojahile.

en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
af: Die berg het die duvet oor sy kop getrek. Verstaanbaar, dis Vrydag.
zu: Intaba izembese ingubo ekhanda. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.

en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
af: Son in, son uit. Maandag warm nog net op.
zu: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMsombuluko uqala kancane.

en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
af: Die wolke het die son Dinsdag afgegee. Niemand het die klamheid laat weet nie.
zu: Amafu anike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibili. Akekho otshele umswakama.

en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
af: Daai wolke is net op deurtog. Selfs die mielies raak nie opgewonde nie.
zu: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nommbila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.

en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
af: Die skaduwee werk die rye een vir een af. Dis besig met inspeksie.
zu: Umthunzi uhamba emigqeni, owodwa ngowodwa. Uyahlola.

en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
af: Pers op die grond, wit in die lug. Vrydag se kleure is goedgekeur.
zu: I-purple phansi, okumhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamukelwe.

en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
af: 'n Paar wolke het kom kyk. Hulle hardloop ook nie.
zu: Amafu ambalwa eze ukuzobuka. Nawo awagijimi.

en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
af: Die wolke dryf stadig verby. Dis Sondag; hulle mag.
zu: Amafu adlula kancane. YiSonto; avunyelwe.

en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
af: Die berg se tafeldoek is net half op. Dis Maandag, niemand is heeltemal aangetrek nie.
zu: Indwangu yetafula yentaba igqokwe uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.

en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
af: Wolkskaduwees stap teen 'n rustige pas oor die veld. Niemand appelleer nie.
zu: Izithunzi zamafu zihamba kancane ziwela inkundla. Akekho okhalazayo.

en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
af: Son, dan wolk, dan son. Selfs die apies kan nie daarvolgens beplan nie.
zu: Ilanga, bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela ngalokho.

en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
af: Die hond het die presiese lyn tussen son en skadu gekry. Hy bly net daar.
zu: Inja ithole umngcele ngqo phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ihlala khona.

en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
af: Sonbril op, sonbril af, sonbril op. Vrydagmiddag is intervaloefening.
zu: Izibuko zelanga ziyagqokwa, ziyakhunyulwa, ziyagqokwa. ULwesihlanu ntambama kungukuzivocavoca.

en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
af: Een wolk oor die berg is nie weer nie. Die vuur bly aan.
zu: Ifu elilodwa phezu kwentaba alisona isimo sezulu. Umlilo uqhubeka uvutha.

en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
af: Wolk oor die berg, potjie onder die lapa. Albei kort nog 'n uur.
zu: Ifu phezu kwentaba, i-potjie ngaphansi kwe-lapa. Kokubili kusadinga elinye ihora.

en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
af: Die wolke het laat gebly net vir die kleur. Maandag skuld almal soveel.
zu: Amafu ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMsombuluko ubukweleta wonke umuntu lokho.

en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
af: Wolke die hele middag, nie 'n druppel nie. Die tuinslang is weer aan diens.
zu: Amafu ntambama yonke, akukho ngisho nethonsi. Ipayipi lamanzi libuyele emsebenzini.

en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
af: Die lug hou 'n vertoning. Die vis, soos gewoonlik, nie.
zu: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi, njengenjwayelo, azenzi.

en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
af: Wolke vir die sonsondergang, sproeiers vir die wingerd. Die plaas reël sy eie reën.
zu: Amafu okushona kwelanga, amanzi okunisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizilungiselela imvula yalo.

en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
af: Die son het afgeteken. Die wolke gloei nog, en die balkon ook.
zu: Ilanga seliphumile emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, ne-balcony nayo.

en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
af: Die wolke het pienk geword net toe dit tyd was om op te pak. Niemand het opgepak nie.
zu: Amafu aphenduke abe yi-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.

en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
af: Die beeste is tuis voor die kleur weg is. Sondag eindig presies op tyd.
zu: Izinkomo sezisekhaya ngaphambi kokuba umbala uphele. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.

en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
af: Die maan is vanaand op 'n dimmer. Die sekuriteitslig het nie so 'n knoppie nie.
zu: Inyanga ikhanya kancane kulobu busuku. Isibani sezokuphepha asinalo lelo khono.

en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
af: Halfmaan, halfwolk, vol drom. Dinsdagaand, soos geadverteer.
zu: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wefu, umgqomo ugcwele. NguLwesibili ebusuku, njengoba kumenyezelwe.

en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
af: Die maan loer kort-kort uit om die vulstasie te check. Steeds niks aan die gang nie.
zu: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka igaraji likaphethiloli. Akukho okwenzekayo.

en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
af: Die wolke gee die maan vir mekaar aan. Die balkon wag graag.
zu: Amafu adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye. I-balcony iyajabula ukulinda.

en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
af: Die maan kom tussen die wolke deur kuier. Hy ruik die vleis van daar bo af.
zu: Inyanga ivakashela phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama isezulwini.

en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
af: Die helfte van die sterre is agter wolke. Die liggies staan vir hulle in.
zu: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zenza umsebenzi wazo.

en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
af: Maan agter 'n wolk, hond op die stoep. Sondag se diens is verby.
zu: Inyanga ingemuva kwefu, inja iku-stoep. Inkonzo yangeSonto iphelile.

en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
af: Dis 6 uur en die yskas is nou al die gewildste vertrek in die huis.
zu: Ngu-6 ekuseni kanti ifriji isivele iyindawo ethandwa kakhulu endlini.

en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
af: Die hond geniet hierdie wind. Hy het die enigste haarstyl wat daarvoor gebou is.
zu: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyona yodwa enesitayela sezinwele esenzelwe wona.

en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
af: Behoorlik koud vandag. Die soort wat deur drie truie gaan asof hulle nie daar is nie.
zu: Kubanda impela namuhla. Uhlobo olungena emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.

en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
af: Selfs dié wat sweer dit word nooit koud nie, erken dit nou.
zu: Ngisho nalabo abafunga ukuthi akuze kubande bayavuma manje.

en: Somebody's mom is going to have words. Worth it.
af: Iemand se ma gaan iets sê. Dit was die moeite werd.
zu: Umama womuntu othile uzothethisa. Kodwa bekumnandi.

en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.
af: Die son buffer nog. Moenie die bladsy verfris nie.
zu: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungalivuseleli ikhasi.

en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.
af: Geen kleure in die lug vanaand nie, net skakerings van rustig.
zu: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kuphela ukuthula.

en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.
af: Die aand kom binne op sokkies.
zu: Kusihlwa kufika ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.

en: Tomorrow is a fresh negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.
af: Môre is 'n nuwe onderhandeling met die weer. Vanaand rus ons.
zu: Kusasa yingxoxo entsha nesimo sezulu. Kulobu busuku siyaphumula.

en: Clouds today, vibes optional.
af: Windgat wolke vandag.
zu: Amafu namuhla. Imizwa yona ikuwe.

en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.
af: Kaapstad stuur sterkte. En 'n ekstra pet.
zu: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elingeziwe.

en: The South-Easter has no off switch. We've looked.
af: Die Suidoos het nie 'n af-knoppie nie. Ons het gesoek.
zu: I-South-Easter ayinayo iswishi yokuyicima. Siyifunile.

en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
af: Die tafeldoek is gestryk en reg vir môre se diens.
zu: Indwangu yetafula ilungisiwe, ilungele umsebenzi wakusasa.

en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.
af: Mooiste blou lug in die land, en dit voel soos 'n yskas met uitsig.
zu: Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.

en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.
af: Forelweer. Vir die vis is dit lekker. Vir die visserman is dit karakterbou.
zu: Isimo sezulu se-trout. Kumnandi ezinhlanzini. Kuyakha isimilo somdobi.

en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
af: Die blesbokke dra nie serpe nie en kla ook nie. Ons kan iets leer. Ons gaan nie, maar ons kan.
zu: Ama-blesbok awagqoki zikhafu futhi awakhali. Singafunda okuthile. Ngeke, kodwa singafunda.

en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
af: Elektriese kombers weer vergeet om vooraf aan te sit. Elke. Enkele. Aand.
zu: Ngikhohlwe ukuvula ingubo kagesi kusenesikhathi. Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.

en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.
af: Daardie een liggie is iemand wat winter reg doen: hut, vuur, klaar.
zu: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: indlu yotshani, umlilo, kuphelile.

en: The 7am sun isn't giving heat yet. Only vibes.
af: Sewe-uur se son deel nog nie hitte uit nie, net vibes.
zu: Ilanga lango-7 ekuseni alikakhiphi ukushisa. Yi-vibe nje.

en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.
af: Die son doen sy admin buite. Hitte is nie deel van die pakket nie.
zu: Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungeyona ingxenye yephakethe.

en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.
af: Kaapstad ná 'n front: skoon, helder, en yskoud eerlik.
zu: IKapa ngemuva kwe-front: licwebile, liyakhanya, futhi liyabanda impela.

en: One blanket, two people, zero shame.
af: Een kombers, twee mense, geen skaamte nie.
zu: Ingubo eyodwa, abantu ababili, amahloni awekho.

en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
af: Die Karoo maak nou die dak oop. Trek warm aan vir die vertoning.
zu: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Gqoka izingubo ezifudumele ukubuka umbukiso.

en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
af: Die maan het die berge aangeskakel. Die hitte, egter, nie.
zu: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukushisa akuvulwanga.

en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
af: Die see is 12 grade. Teen tienuur gaan dit soos 'n spa voel.
zu: Ulwandle luyi-12 degrees. Ngo-10 kuzozwakala njenge-spa.

en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
af: Ons praat nie oor vandag nie. Vandag is verby. Ons is trots op ons.
zu: Asikhulumi nganamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya ngathi.

en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.
af: Die klippe gaan vannag nog die dag se hitte uitdeel. Verniet.
zu: Amatshe azokwaba ukushisa kwanamuhla ubusuku bonke. Mahhala.

en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.
af: Die hele stad het vanaand dieselfde plan gehad. Kyk hoe lyk ons.
zu: Lonke idolobha libe nesu elifanayo kulobu busuku. Bheka thina sonke.

en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.
af: Die sproeier is kamma vir die gras. Kyk wie staan almal in die water.
zu: Amanzi okunisela kuthiwa awotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abemi emanzini.

en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.
af: Moenie stres nie — die berge buffer nog.
zu: Phumula, izintaba zisalayisha nje.

en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
af: Elke venster wat aangaan is iemand wat besluit het: genoeg vir vandag.
zu: Ifasitela ngalinye elikhanyayo ngumuntu onquma ukuthi: kwanele namuhla.

en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
af: Perfekte weer om iemand raak te loop wat jy 'nog wou bel'.
zu: Isimo sezulu esihle sokuhlangana nomuntu 'obekumele umshayele ucingo'.

en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.
af: Die mishoring is Seepunt se gratis witgeraas-masjien.
zu: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusicula ukuze silale, mahhala.

en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.
af: Die son vat sy tyd vanoggend, en dit wys.
zu: Ilanga lithathe isikhathi salo ekuseni. Ukulinda bekukufanele.

en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.
af: Só 'n dag koop jy nie. Jy kry hom net.
zu: Izinsuku ezinje azisebenzelwa. Ziyanikezwa.

en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
af: Die son gaan af soos hy weet ons kyk.
zu: Ilanga lishona kancane, lizibukisa ngempela. Kodwa liyakufanele.

en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
af: Midlands-mis: die platteland se privaatheid-instelling.
zu: Inkungu yase-Midlands: isilungiselelo sobumfihlo sasemaphandleni.

en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
af: Stap nou of stap glad nie. Die Laeveld gee jou tot sewe-uur.
zu: Hamba manje noma ungahambi nhlobo. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngu-7.

en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
af: Selfs die rooibokke staan in die skadu en heroorweeg hul keuses.
zu: Ngisho nezimpala zimi emthunzini zicabanga kabusha ngezinqumo zazo.

en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
af: Laeveld-somer: jy sweet nie, jy smelt met waardigheid.
zu: Ihlobo lase-Lowveld: awujuluki, uyancibilika ngesithunzi.

en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
af: Die bosveld is vandag op stille modus. Almal. Alles.
zu: I-bushveld ise-silent mode namuhla. Wonke umuntu. Yonke into.

en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
af: Sundowners is nie 'n luukse in die Laeveld nie. Dis medies.
zu: Ama-sundowner akuwona ubukhazikhazi e-Lowveld. Angumuthi.

en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
af: Gqeberha, ons weet. Ons wéét.
zu: Gqeberha, siyazi. Siyazi impela.

en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
af: Die Vriendelike Stad het nie gevra om die Winderige Stad te wees nie, en tog.
zu: Idolobha Elinobungane alikaze licele ukuba yiDolobha Elinomoya, kodwa noma kunjalo.

en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
af: Jeffreysbaai: waar die wind oefen voor sy Kaapse skof.
zu: IJeffreys Bay: lapho umoya uzilolongela khona ngaphambi kweshifu yawo eKapa.

en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
af: Gqeberha slaap nie, dit hou net vas.
zu: IGqeberha ayilali, ibambelela nje.

en: Breezy
af: Ligte briesie
zu: Kunomoya omncane

en: Bit of a breeze.
af: 'n Bietjie briesie.
zu: Kunomoya omncane.
